title: Upadacitinib topical formulation null screen
summary: Three lipid-based carriers for Upadacitinib each scored SR9 far below the 0.80 honesty gate and were all correctly rejected. Early pipeline run with manual operator context. The honest public reading is a confirmed negative: the gate worked correctly.
findings: Liposomal Gel: SR9 = 0.258 — rejected (below 0.80 honesty gate)
All 3 carriers rejected in under 2 hours; pipeline correctly declined to claim efficacy
